evidence: The ALD chamber is connected to rf sputtering chamber through load lock to form a cluster system. Thus, a sample can be transferred between these two chambers without breaking vacuum. Ru thin films were deposited using RuCp 2 as a precursor and O 2 as an oxidative reactant. The bubbler containing RuCp 2 powder was heated to 85 °C to produce sufficient vapor pressure. The generated vapor was delivered to the reaction chamber by argon (Ar) carrier gas at a flow rate of 20 sccm for the exposure time of 2 s. Argon purging gas at a flow rate of 50 sccm was delivered to the reaction chamber between a pulse of RuCp 2 and O2 gas in each deposition cycle for 2 s.
